crossRefs.note: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

translations.web: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.
translations.bsb: They were all encouraged and took some food themselves.
translations.kjv: Then were they all of good cheer, and they also took some meat.
translations.asv: Then were they all of good cheer, and themselves also took food.
